stories.headline: 👨🏿‍🚀TechCabal Daily – Ghana courts a Leo
stories.summary: Ghana is in early-stage discussions with Amazon to potentially deploy its Project Kuiper low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite broadband service in the country. The initiative aims to boost high-speed internet connectivity and expand coverage to underserved and rural areas across Ghana.

stories.headline: Vietnam gains from Samsung Electro-Mechanics’s US$4.9B AI substrate expansion plan
stories.summary: Samsung Electro-Mechanics is investing US$4.9 billion to expand its production of chip-packaging substrates in South Korea and Vietnam. Driven by the global artificial intelligence boom, this represents the company's largest single-product investment to date and aims to strengthen the semiconductor supply chain.
